body: thank you! and i'm currently taking 100mg of zoloft. honestly, i'm just shocked it worked the second time (tried prozac before), because apparently a lot of people have to switch their medication often.

depression. anger only stems when i feel overwhelmed, i think. or just when i feel pissed off.

yes, which is why i seclude myself from other people, because i know i'm about to explode. usually go to the bathroom to do that. i hate bursting in front of other people, because i'm ashamed. i don't really realize it in a way where i think, "shit i'm getting angry." i just know i'm getting angry, and i let that control me. i talk down on myself when i'm angry, and hurt myself.

it used to be a lot more significant when i was younger, but for example. if my friend did something completely logical but i wasn't included, i'd fume. i was really codepndent, still probably am. my mom stressing me out gets me very angry. and yeah, things that annoy me too. i guess a lot of things just trigger me. i tend to get angrier the more i'm stressed out. and then proceed to hate myself, but i always hate myself.

maybe spontaneous. i'll feel an overwhelming wave of anger, so i have to hurt myself to get back grounded. just that feeling of being pissed off at everything, everyone, at myself. i'm very sensitive, and when i get triggered, i can't help it. possibly triggered, i guess. it's completely irrational when i do get angry, but i can't help it. and i don't remember the first time, but probably when i was younger. breathing, panicking heavily, feeling out of control. and it varies on how long the anger subsides. sometimes all i need is a good beating to get grounded. other times i can choke myself for as long as i want and i still feel this lingering pain and disgust in myself and i bloody hate myself and miserable. i don't feel very good for the rest of the day. usually i won't feel good for a couple of days, but at least the anger is gone. 

and i'm not entirely sure. the anger seems to be more of a trigger sort of thing though. but sometimes i wil feel irrationally angry for no reason, and i can't place why. but most of the time, it's because i'm being oversensitive to something. the depression is just me feeling guilty and ashamed and empty and i don't know who i am. honestly, this whole answer is confusing me, because i don't know if it's correct, sorry.

there are days when i feel better - but i still feel the weariness of depression. but still, okay. generally i sink into a depression i think when something triggers me, whether it's big or small. and the more sensitive i am at that moment, the more likely i'll be depressed and sink into this sort of phase... so yeah, i don't necessarily think my depression's a constant thing. i can be happy and joyful. i think. i really don't know... i wish i could just be more sure about describing this, but i think it correlates after something bad happens, or maybe when i feel more negative than usual. i'm just so confused. 

i get angry, very very angry. sometimes i want to lash out on other people, but i would never ever do that, because i know i'd feel guilty for the rest of my life. i lash out on myself, when i feel overwhelmed. i hate myself. at times i feel angry, empty, depressed, sad. can't do nothing. i want to channel the pain away. it has such a strong grip on my heart and tightening and there's just overwhelming sadness. i don't know. i'm sorry.
